metaDescription: Order custom beach lotion for your next event. Sun Bum kits available. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Beach-themed lotion is a natural fit for summer events, resort giveaways, and outdoor company picnics. Unlike generic moisturizer, custom beach lotion signals sun, sand, and relaxation — making it an instant hit with employees or guests. Whether you choose a branded Sun Bum kit or a custom-labeled sunscreen, your logo on beach lotion keeps your brand top-of-mind all season long. Silkscreen or label decoration options let you match your brand colors perfectly.
